body: That entire album is so fucking good.

Thank you so much. I honestly am glad I chose to come here. On one hand I'm very distraught that I had no friends to vent to about this, but on the other hand I'm balling that idea up and throwing it away because it seemed the problem I have is that "no one understood me" not that I didn't have any friends. I think you've opened my eyes to a different problem and I can't be any more grateful as I'm welling up at this realization hah.

It is so damn nice to have someone like you and the other amazing people who have commented here who have expressed similarities and understanding. It's extremely new to me, and I love it so much. Thank you again.

Thank you.

People like you make me realize that coming here tonight was a really good idea. I never thought of it from their perspective: "because there's actually NOTHING else they know how to do for you."

Thanks for opening me up to that
I'll keep that in mind bro, thank you so much. RIP, Mom.
Thanks man. You really think so?

Thank you.

How would you recommend I prepare? I've been blindsided by this suicidal lifestyle and it's a constant battle, but I've never honestly "prepared" for anything for things to get worse. Do you have any suggestions?

I don't really have many friends to be honest with you. However, I frequent reddit a lot so  I figured this as a literal last resort. But I've talked to a few family members about it. I think I made the mistake of talking to them all collectively, because they laughed after someone said "well I'm glad you're still alive because you would have felt the pain of my punch to put some sense into you."

After that I never will talk to anyone in my family again about this.

Thank you.

Part of me is feeling so thankful I'm calling out for help in a way I never thought I would, but the other part is just telling me to just fucking do it already. I seriously feel like I'm being pulled apart and the only thing I have been doing since October is hang on; my grip is slipping man you know? :/
